name: @qa-portal/shared
description: Common building blocks every module/shell app needs (Table incl. its filter icon/popover, Modal, Badge, api client, auth context, shared types/constants). Not independently built or deployed -- each consuming app (shell + the 4 module remotes) resolves the `@qa-portal/shared` specifier straight to this package's src/ via a Vite resolve.alias + a matching TS `paths` entry (see any package's vite.config.ts/tsconfig.json), so it compiles as part of whichever app imports it rather than as its own bundle. This is deliberate: it keeps one canonical copy of these building blocks (no drift between 5 separate copies) without needing an npm registry/publish step in a project that isn't published anywhere.
